title: Guestbook
goal: Turn the page into a guestbook. The page has a text input with the placeholder "Your name", a text input with the placeholder "Message", a button labelled "Sign", and the list of stored entries. Entries are stored on the server as `Entry` nodes connected to root, with fields `name: str` and `message: str`. Clicking Sign stores an entry and shows it in the list as "name: message", then clears both inputs. Stored entries are shown when the page loads. You may remove the Ping button.
